description_en: Updates the configuration of an Agent
name: UpdateAgent

parameters.help_en: The name of the Agent to update
parameters.help_zh: 要更新的 Agent 名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The expected current configuration revision number. This parameter is omitted by default. For concurrency protection, pass in the `AgentVersion` returned by the most recent `GetAgent` call
parameters.help_zh: 期望的当前配置修订号，默认省略；需要并发保护时传入最近一次 `GetAgent` 返回的 `AgentVersion`
parameters.name: expected_version

parameters.example: CR 代码与安全评审 Agent
parameters.help_en: The new display name. If not specified, the existing value is retained
parameters.help_zh: 新的展示名称；不传则保持原值
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.example: 分析 CR 代码变更并检查正确性、安全性和可维护性
parameters.help_en: The new description. If not specified, the existing value is retained
parameters.help_zh: 新的描述；不传则保持原值
parameters.name: description

parameters.example: 请检查 CR 中的代码缺陷、安全风险和兼容性问题，并给出可执行的修改建议。
parameters.help_en: The new system prompt. If not specified, the existing value is retained
parameters.help_zh: 新的系统提示词；不传则保持原值
parameters.name: system_prompt

parameters.help_en: The list of MCP Server and Connector name references. The same array supports both types of entries. Each entry specifies one type of reference. If items is omitted for an MCP entry, all public tools are included. Previously specified items retain their existing values
parameters.help_zh: MCP Server 与 Connector 名称引用列表，同一数组支持两类条目并存；每个条目填写一种引用。MCP 省略 items 表示全部公开工具，历史明确的 items 保持原值
parameters.name: tools

parameters.help_en: The list of Skill references. If not specified, the existing value is retained. A non-empty array replaces the entire value. Passing `[ ]` removes all bindings
parameters.help_zh: Skill 引用列表；不传保持原值，传非空数组整体替换，传 `[ ]` 解除全部绑定
parameters.name: skills

parameters.help_en: The list of knowledge base bindings, which contains at most one element. If not specified, the existing value is retained. A non-empty array replaces the entire value. Passing `[ ]` removes all bindings
parameters.help_zh: 知识库绑定列表，最多包含一个元素；不传保持原值，传非空数组整体替换，传 `[ ]` 解除全部绑定
parameters.name: knowledge_bases

parameters.help_en:
The new visibility scope. Valid values:
user
tenant

If not specified, the existing value is retained
parameters.help_zh: 新的可见范围。可选值为 `user` 和 `tenant`；不传则保持原值
parameters.name: visibility

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, used for Tracing Analysis and troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于链路追踪和问题排查

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the Agent was successfully updated. A successful response always returns `true`. A failure returns an error response
Success.description_zh: Agent 是否已成功更新。成功响应固定返回 `true`；失败时返回错误响应

UpdatedAt.description_en: The most recent update time, as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
UpdatedAt.description_zh: 最近更新时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
